chinese_source: Xi'an Stele (781), corroborated in outline by Tang Huiyao fasc. 49
event: Alopen arrives at Chang'an from Daqin carrying scriptures and images; received by Fang Xuanling; the scriptures are translated in the imperial library
firmness_reason: Retrospective by 146 years on the stele; no contemporary Tang document records the arrival itself, though the 638 edict and the church's Tang presence are independently recorded
indian_entity: Alopen's mission — first documented Church of the East arrival in China
notes: Dates the ARRIVAL of the Church of the East in China — a transmission event. It attests the institution that carried the Thomas tradition east; it is not evidence about Thomas (1st c.).
